openFormats.title: Open formats
openFormats.intro: Plain files for your own analysis: CSV opens in Excel, Numbers or LibreOffice; JSON Lines (one JSON object per line) loads straight into Python, R or any script. Genotypes are one row per SNP with a column per person; findings are every knowledge-base match with its evidence; the health log is one row per entry.
openFormats.plaintextWarning: These files are unencrypted and contain genetic and health data. Keep them where only you can read them.
openFormats.sharedOnly: Genotypes: only SNPs every person has a call for (the comparable set; untick for the union of all files, which can exceed a spreadsheet's 1,048,576-row limit)
